$comment: Per-agent-kind model menus for the composer's Model picker. POLICY lives here, out of the .ts code (mechanism is models.ts). Each entry: { value: the id passed as the agent's model arg, label: the menu row text }. Edit this file to add/remove/rename models — no code change. Version-agnostic aliases first, then pinned ids. The composer always also offers a free-text 'Custom model id…' row, so this list need not be exhaustive. A kind absent here (e.g. generic) gets no Model pill.
